basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old from Toronto, Canada, currently juggling a part-time job as a barista while finishing my degree in Environmental Science. I've recently developed an interest in gaming, particularly looking to explore single-player experiences. Cycling is another passion of mine, and I spend weekends exploring trails with my road bike. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or class. I'm in a relationship and we often find ourselves debating over which game to dive into next.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm relatively new to the gaming world. My knowledge is mostly gathered from online forums, YouTube reviews, and the occasional recommendation from friends. My academic focus is in Environmental Science, but I've self-taught myself a lot about bikes, which is a big hobby of mine.
